## Firefox Enterprise

Launching today

Firefox for enterprises that want control of their data

Firefox Enterprise brings Mozilla's independent browser technology to organizations that want more control over their IT infrastructure and data. Built on the Gecko engine, it offers a self-hosted management console for centrally managing browser policies, access, data movement, and AI usage. It works alongside existing identity, security, and device management systems, helping enterprises reduce dependence on dominant browser ecosystems.

Mozilla just introduced Firefox Enterprise, and I think the timing is interesting. Most companies rely on Chrome or Edge, which are both built on Chromium. Firefox gives them an independent browser engine, and now there's an enterprise offering with a management console they can run on their own infrastructure. IT teams can manage browser policies, access, data movement, and AI usage without handing over control of the management layer. Mozilla is starting in Europe, where digital sovereignty has become a pretty big topic. Nice to see another serious option for enterprise browsers.
